symbols.name: EventMap
symbols.description: Native events dispatched through `Events.on`. Each property is the exact callback argument tuple for that event.

properties.name: resourceStart
properties.description: Dispatched after a resource entry point has run and immediately before the resource becomes running.

properties.name: resourceStop
properties.description: Dispatched while a resource is stopping, before its stop callback, timers, exports and event handlers are cleaned up.

properties.name: consoleCommand
properties.description: Dispatched after the server console parses a command line that no built-in command handles.

properties.name: missionChange
properties.description: Dispatched after World.changeMission has reset the world and asked every client to load the new mission.

properties.name: missionReady
properties.description: Dispatched once each time every connected player has loaded the current mission generation. At least one player must be connected.

properties.name: playerMissionReady
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client has loaded the current mission.

properties.name: playerMissionUnloaded
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client has unloaded its mission.

properties.name: playerMissionLoadFailed
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client could not load the current mission.

properties.name: playerConnect
properties.description: Dispatched after a player has connected and has a player handle. The player is not spawned yet.

properties.name: playerDisconnect
properties.description: Dispatched while a player disconnects, before the player handle stops resolving.

properties.name: playerVoiceStart
properties.description: Dispatched when a player starts speaking on voice chat, including when no one is in earshot.

properties.name: playerVoiceStop
properties.description: Dispatched shortly after a player's last voice frame reaches the server. A disconnect ends speech without this event.

properties.name: playerChat
properties.description: Dispatched for an accepted, sanitized chat line after it was relayed.

properties.name: playerCommand
properties.description: Dispatched when a chat line starting with `/` passes the chat rate limit.

properties.name: playerNicknameChange
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.setNickname changed the name.

properties.name: playerModelChange

properties.name: playerMoneyChange

properties.name: doorStateChange

properties.name: doorLockChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a script changes a mission door lock.

properties.name: doorInteractionChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a script enables or disables native door use.

properties.name: mapObjectMoved
properties.description: Dispatched after a MapObject.moveTo reached its target. A teleport, stop or new move does not dispatch it for the move it replaced.

properties.name: fireExtinguished
properties.description: Dispatched once a fire's intensity reaches 0. The fire stays, smoking, until destroyed.

properties.name: playerSpawn

properties.name: playerCrime
properties.description: Dispatched when the simulation host's police manager records a new crime of a player. The player's wanted level may rise with it (playerWantedChange).

properties.name: playerWantedChange
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's wanted level changes: the police raise it for a crime, a script sets it, an arrest or Police.clear settles it, the officers lose the player, or a new simulation host takes over (every record starts again at 0).

properties.description: Dispatched once for each Police.sendBackup request when the simulation host answers it. The player is the one the police car hunts; its officers join the NPCs (npcSpawn, kind police).

properties.name: taxiHailEnd

properties.description: Dispatched once when the taxi stops within 10 m of the waving walker (retail's boarding moment). The walker keeps waving for 15 seconds; Taxi.board makes it the passenger.

properties.name: taxiPassengerEnter
properties.description: Dispatched when a Taxi.board passenger sat down in the player's car.

properties.name: taxiArrive
properties.description: Dispatched once when the taxi stands still (0.5 m/s or less) within the radius of Taxi.setDestination's point with the passenger aboard.

properties.name: taxiPassengerExit
properties.description: Dispatched when a Taxi.board passenger's ride ends: it got out (it then walks off and is removed out of sight), never got in, died or is gone.

type.name: [player: Player | null, passenger: Npc | null, vehicle: Vehicle | null, info: TaxiPassengerExitInfo]

properties.name: playerArrest
properties.description: Dispatched when a simulation host police officer finished arresting or fining a player. Nothing else happens to the player: the game goes on and the script decides the outcome. The player's crime record is cleared.

properties.name: vehicleTrafficTaken
properties.description: Dispatched when a car the simulation host drove becomes the player's: the host stops driving it and the player's client simulates it. After a steal the player gets in with the next use, as in retail.

properties.name: vehicleStealRefused
properties.description: Dispatched when the server refused a player's steal of a traffic car: the car moved out of reach or was not standing still, another player took it first or its driver had left. A player's repeated try within 500 ms is refused without this event. The player's client already played the pull-out; the driver stays in the car.

properties.name: playerThrownOut
properties.description: Dispatched after vehiclePlayerExited when a simulation host NPC pulled the player out of the seat (retail Do_ThrowCocotFromCar).

properties.name: vehicleRefuel
properties.description: Dispatched when the attendant's fuel animation ends its pumping (retail EndPumpFuel), after the server has set the car's fuel (vehicleFuelChange) and taken the money (playerMoneyChange). The car stays locked until he is back at his post.

type.name: [vehicle: Vehicle, player: Player | null, info: VehicleRefuelInfo]

properties.name: pumperRefused
properties.description: Dispatched when the server refuses the retail "use the pump" choice of a driver stopped at a pump. The attendant stays where he is and the car is not locked.

properties.name: vehicleEngineChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleFuelChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleLightsChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleHornChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleSirenChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleGearChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleDamageState
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleDamage
properties.description: Dispatched when the native per-part damage snapshot changes.

properties.name: vehicleOpacityChange
properties.description: Dispatched after Vehicle.setOpacity changes the server-owned opacity.

properties.name: vehicleRepair

properties.name: vehicleTerminal
properties.description: Dispatched when a vehicle explodes (1), its native body hits water (2), or it enters a fall volume or native invalid-fall state (3). Water and fall occupants die through server combat immediately after this event; explosion occupants die before it. Scripts decide when to destroy the car.

properties.name: vehicleHit
properties.description: Dispatched when a pellet hit is replayed to the vehicle's simulation controller, before the resulting vehicleDamage.

properties.name: vehiclePartDetached
properties.description: Dispatched when the server accepts a native loose part from the vehicle's controller.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerEntering
properties.description: Dispatched when the server accepts the start of a native enter or steal.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerEntered
properties.description: Dispatched when a player sits in a seat, natively or through Player.putInVehicle.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerExited
properties.description: Dispatched when a player leaves a seat, including by death, respawn or removeFromVehicle.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerExitBlocked
properties.description: Dispatched when a script records an administrative blocked exit; native blocked exits use seat transfer or the retail emergency exit.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerSeatChanged
properties.description: Dispatched after a blocked-side exit moves the player into the paired seat. info.fromSeat is the prior seat.

properties.name: entityStateChange
properties.description: Dispatched when one key of an entity's state changes: on the server when a script writes it, on a client when the write arrives. `value` is undefined when the key was removed and `previous` is undefined when it held nothing before, so a stored null stays distinguishable from an absent key. The entity is whatever the game's WrapScriptEntity answers, and the base Entity handle by default.

type.name: [entity: Entity, key: string, value: any, previous: any]

properties.name: playerConnecting
properties.description: Dispatched when a player asks to join, before the connection exists: they hold no player slot, are not counted as online, and are sent nothing -- no resource list, no download, no body. The request waits until every handler has returned and every Promise a handler returned has settled, then it is let in if a player slot is free (otherwise it is refused as full). `connection.reject()` turns it away instead, and so does a handler that throws or rejects, or handlers that have not settled within the server's admission timeout (30 seconds by default, restarted by every `connection.update()`). With no handler at all, every request is let in at once.

symbols.name: Player
symbols.description: A connected Mafia 1 player. The server owns its life, health, inventory and seat; every change goes through server validation and replicates to all clients.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for an existing connected player; it does not create a player.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this player for logging.

returns.description: The player ID and nickname.

functions.name: kick
functions.description: Disconnects this player.

functions.name: emit
functions.description: Emits a named script event to this player's client.

parameters.name: payloadJson
parameters.description: JSON payload forwarded to the client.

functions.name: getIP
functions.description: Returns this player's remote network address.

returns.description: Address, or an empty string when unavailable.

functions.name: setNickname
functions.description: Applies the nickname policy: invalid characters are removed, whitespace collapsed, the name cut to 24 characters, and a taken name gets a numbered suffix. Fires playerNicknameChange when the name changes.

returns.description: The nickname actually used, or null when the player has left.

functions.name: setModel
functions.description: Selects this player's human model on every client, including during a life. The choice persists across respawns and mission changes. Fires playerModelChange when it changes.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Stock human .i3d filename, 5 to 64 ASCII characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, dash, or dot.

returns.description: False for an invalid filename or a disconnected player.

functions.name: setNametag
functions.description: Changes this player's nametag.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Only the given fields change. color is 0xRRGGBB and also colors the name in chat; an empty text restores the nickname.

type.name: { visible?: boolean; showHealth?: boolean; color?: number; text?: string }

returns.description: False when the player has left.

functions.name: setNametagVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides this player's nametag.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether other players see this player's name.

functions.name: setNametagHealthVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the health bar under this player's name.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether the health bar is shown.

functions.name: setNametagText
functions.description: Overrides this player's nametag label.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Label to show instead of the nickname; empty restores it.

functions.name: setNametagColor
functions.description: Tints this player's nametag and chat name.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB color; the alpha is always opaque.

functions.name: sendMessage
functions.description: Sends a private chat notice to this player.

returns.description: False when the player has left or the text is invalid.

functions.name: spawn
functions.description: Starts a new life with 100 health and an empty inventory once every client is mission ready. A seat held by the previous life is released and recorded as an exit. Fires playerSpawn.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Spawn position; three numbers x, y, z are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Facing in radians around the vertical axis; defaults to 0.

returns.description: False before every client is ready, for an invalid position, or when the player has left.

functions.name: respawn
functions.description: Starts a new life after death, like spawn. The server never respawns anyone by itself. Fires playerRespawn.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Spawn position; three numbers x, y, z are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False when the life could not be started.

functions.name: despawn
functions.description: Ends the current life and clears its seat. Fires playerDespawn.

returns.description: False when the player has left.

functions.name: getSuggestedSpawn
functions.description: Returns the native scene spawn hint the player's client reported for the current mission.

returns.description: The hint, or null before the client reported one.

functions.name: setHealth
functions.description: Sets server health, firing playerDamage, playerDeath or playerHealthChange. A dead player cannot be revived this way; use respawn.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: Health from 0 to 100; values outside are clamped.

returns.description: False when there is no living, spawned player.

functions.name: setMoney
functions.description: Sets this player's server balance. Fires playerMoneyChange when it changes.

returns.description: False if the player has disconnected.

functions.name: giveMoney
functions.description: Adds or removes money without exceeding the balance bounds. Fires playerMoneyChange when it changes.

returns.description: False if the result would be negative or above the maximum, or the player has disconnected.

functions.name: trySpendMoney
functions.description: Atomically checks and debits this player's server balance. Use the return value to grant shop goods. Fires playerMoneyChange on a nonzero purchase.

returns.description: False if the player cannot afford the cost or has disconnected.

functions.name: getVehicle
functions.description: Returns the vehicle whose seat the current life holds.

returns.description: The vehicle, or null on foot.

functions.name: getCameraTarget
functions.description: Returns the player this client's camera follows when scripted, or null for the local camera.

returns.description: The connected target, or null.

functions.name: setCameraTarget
functions.description: Makes this player's camera follow the target on foot and switch to the target's car while seated. The choice persists across both players' respawns; a missing or despawned target temporarily falls back to the observer.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Connected player to follow, or null to restore the local camera.

returns.description: False when the observer has left or the target is not connected in the same mission.

functions.name: getSeat
functions.description: Returns the seat the current life holds; 0 is the driver.

returns.description: The seat, or null on foot.

functions.name: putInVehicle
functions.description: Records the player as seated through the server seat path, as if the native entry had completed; it does not play the door animation. Seat 0 makes this player's client the vehicle's simulation controller. Fires vehiclePlayerEntered.

parameters.name: vehicle
parameters.description: Vehicle to seat the player in.

returns.description: False for a dead or unspawned player, another mission's vehicle, or a seat that is taken or out of range.

functions.name: removeFromVehicle
functions.description: Records the player's current seat as exited without the native exit animation. Fires vehiclePlayerExited.

returns.description: False when the player is not seated.

functions.name: giveWeapon
functions.description: Grants a weapon to a living player.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Loaded rounds, or the throwable count; defaults to a full magazine for a firearm and 1 otherwise. A firearm is capped to its magazine.

returns.description: False for a dead player, an unsupported weapon or a full inventory.

functions.name: giveAmmo
functions.description: Adds reserve ammunition to a held weapon.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Reserve delta; a negative amount removes ammunition down to zero.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: setWeaponAmmo
functions.description: Sets the ammunition of a held weapon; it does not grant the weapon.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Loaded rounds; a firearm is capped to its magazine.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: removeWeapon
functions.description: Removes a held weapon.

returns.description: False when it was not held.

functions.name: dropWeapon
functions.description: Moves a held weapon and its ammunition into a replicated pickup at the player's feet. Fires weaponDropped and playerWeaponDrop.

parameters.name: weaponId
parameters.description: Held weapon to drop; defaults to the selected weapon.

returns.description: The new pickup, or null if the player is dead, unspawned, seated, has no selected weapon, does not hold the requested weapon, or the pickup limit is full.

functions.name: removeAllWeapons
functions.description: Holsters and removes every weapon of a living player.

returns.description: False for a dead or unspawned player.

functions.name: setCurrentWeapon
functions.description: Selects a held weapon.

parameters.name: weaponId
parameters.description: A held weapon, or 0 to holster.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: getCurrentWeapon
functions.description: Returns the selected weapon.

returns.description: The weapon ID, 0 when holstered or not spawned.

functions.name: hasWeapon
functions.description: Checks whether the current life holds a weapon.

returns.description: True when it is held.

functions.name: getWeapons
functions.description: Lists the held weapons with their ammunition.

returns.description: The held weapons, empty when not spawned.

functions.name: getInventory
functions.description: Returns the selected weapon and the held weapons.

returns.description: The inventory, or null when not spawned.

functions.name: setInventory
functions.description: Atomically replaces the whole inventory of a living player in one state revision. Without selected, the first entry becomes equipped; an empty list holsters. Duplicate weapons and more than seven items are rejected without changing the current inventory.

parameters.name: weapons
parameters.description: Complete new inventory, at most seven items. Missing ammunition gets the giveWeapon defaults.

type.name: { weaponId: number; loaded?: number; reserve?: number }[]

returns.description: False when the player is not alive, an item repeats, more than seven items are supplied, or selected is not in the new inventory.

functions.name: addItem
functions.description: Adds one item, or adds its ammunition or throwable count to a weapon already held.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Rounds or count to add; defaults like giveWeapon.

parameters.name: reserve
parameters.description: Reserve rounds to add; defaults to 0.

returns.description: False for a dead player or a full inventory.

functions.name: removeItem
functions.description: Without count removes the item; with count takes that much and removes the item once none is left.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Rounds or throwables to take, reserve first.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: getCombatState
functions.description: Returns the server combat snapshot of this player.

returns.description: The snapshot, or null when the player has none.

properties.description: Snapshot revision.

properties.description: Engine health.

properties.description: Gearbox health.

symbols.name: Vehicle
symbols.description: A server car. The server owns engine, damage, seats and terminal state; the client chosen as simulation controller reports native physics and damage.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for an existing vehicle; use Vehicle.spawn to create one.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this vehicle for logging.

returns.description: The vehicle ID and model.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Fires vehicleDestroy, then removes the vehicle from every client.

returns.description: False when it no longer exists.

functions.name: getController
functions.description: Returns the player whose client simulates this vehicle.

returns.description: The controller, or null.

functions.name: getDriver
functions.description: Returns the current-life occupant of seat 0.

returns.description: The driver, or null.

functions.name: getOccupant
functions.description: Returns the current-life occupant of a seat.

returns.description: The occupant, or null.

functions.name: getOccupants
functions.description: Returns the occupant of every seat.

returns.description: One entry per seat, null when empty.

functions.name: getDoors
functions.description: Returns each seat's door target, from 0 closed to 1 open.

returns.description: One entry per seat.

functions.name: getDamageState
functions.description: Returns the controller's native damage snapshot.

returns.description: The snapshot, or null before the first report or while repair awaits a fresh report.

functions.name: setTransform
functions.description: Sets the authoritative pose; the simulation controller applies it before it reports again.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: New position; three numbers are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Heading in radians or a quaternion; keeps the current rotation when omitted.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: Velocity after the teleport; defaults to zero.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False when the vehicle no longer exists.

functions.name: setEngine
functions.description: Starts or stops the engine. Fires vehicleEngineChange.

returns.description: False for a terminal vehicle.

functions.name: setFuel
functions.description: Sets the fuel; the controller applies and acknowledges it. After the first native tank report, only this server call may increase fuel.

returns.description: False before native dynamics are available or when out of range.

functions.name: setLights
functions.description: Sets the semantic light bits; native blink phase stays game controlled.

returns.description: False before native dynamics are available or for unsupported bits.

functions.name: setHorn
functions.description: Sounds or silences the horn.

returns.description: False before native dynamics are available.

functions.name: setSiren
functions.description: Switches the siren sound and light bar. Drivers toggle it with K.

returns.description: False for a terminal vehicle.

functions.name: setRadarMarker
functions.description: Shows or hides this vehicle on every radar.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether every player's radar shows this vehicle.

returns.description: False when the vehicle no longer exists.

functions.name: setOpacity
functions.description: Changes the car model's opacity on every client. Fires vehicleOpacityChange.

parameters.name: opacity
parameters.description: Visual opacity from 0 transparent to 1 opaque.

returns.description: False for a terminal vehicle or a value outside 0 to 1.

functions.name: saveState
functions.description: Returns an opaque versioned JSON snapshot of all replicated durable condition, including native parts and mesh deformation. Empty until complete native reports arrive. Excludes pose, velocity and occupants.

functions.name: restoreState
functions.description: Restores a saved condition into a fresh unoccupied vehicle of the same model before its first native damage report. Rejects invalid data without mutation.

functions.name: repair
functions.description: Repairs native engine, gearbox, body, fuel tank, lights, attached wheels and deform meshes without resetting position or seats. Fires vehicleRepair.

returns.description: False for a terminal vehicle. Loose debris actors remain until their own lifetime ends.

functions.name: setSeatCount
functions.description: Changes the seat count if the removed seats are empty.

returns.description: False when a removed seat is taken.

functions.name: setDamage
functions.description: Sets script metadata only; it does not deform the car. Fires vehicleDamageState.

returns.description: False when the vehicle no longer exists.

functions.name: setMechanicalDamage
functions.description: Authors a native damage revision the simulation controller applies. Fires vehicleDamage.

parameters.name: engineHealth
parameters.description: Engine health; zero lets the car burn and explode.

returns.description: False before the first native damage snapshot or for out-of-range values.

functions.name: setTerminalState
functions.description: Marks the vehicle terminal and fires vehicleTerminal. Explosion occupants die before the event; water and fall occupants die after it. Scripts decide when to destroy it.

parameters.name: state

returns.description: False when already terminal.

functions.name: explode
functions.description: Same as setTerminalState(1).

returns.description: False when already terminal.

functions.name: recordSeatOutcome
functions.description: Records an administrative seat result without native animation and fires the matching seat event. Entering or stealing seat 0 makes the player's client the simulation controller.

returns.description: False when the result is not valid now.

functions.name: spawn

constructor.name: constructor

symbols.name: Npc
symbols.description: A human the simulation host runs with the retail AI: a gangster pedestrian someone hit that draws a Thompson and fights back, a policeman, a thrown-out driver, or one a script spawned and gives tasks.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for an existing NPC.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this NPC for logging.

returns.description: The NPC ID, kind and model.

functions.name: getInventory
functions.description: Returns the selected weapon and the held weapons the server records for it.

returns.description: The inventory, or null when it no longer exists.

functions.name: getThrownFromVehicle
functions.description: Returns the car a driver NPC was thrown out of when a player stole it.

returns.description: The vehicle, or null for another kind of NPC or once that car is gone.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Asks the simulation host to retire it now; npcRetire follows.

returns.description: False when it no longer exists or no host is attached.

functions.name: follow
functions.description: Follows the target the way retail companions follow Tommy (Entity_ActionFollow), until another task or the target is gone. It runs to catch up and resumes after a fight. The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: How close it keeps, 0.5 to 50; defaults to 2.

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: walkTo
functions.description: Walks over the mission's pedestrian paths to the point (EntityMoveToFrame). With direct it walks straight there instead, the way retail steps a human along its script path (AI_human_goto_target), for rooms the paths do not reach; it fails when something blocks it for 3 seconds. The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Where to go; three numbers are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: run: run instead of walking; radius: how close it must come, 0.3 to 20 (default 0.5); direct: walk in a straight line without the pedestrian paths.

type.name: { run?: boolean; radius?: number; direct?: boolean }

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: enterVehicle
functions.description: Walks to the car's door and gets in (Entity_MoveToCar, Enemy_UseCar). The simulation host drives the car while a scripted NPC boards or sits in it, and players cannot get in meanwhile; in a passenger seat of a car a player drives, the player keeps driving and the NPC rides along on every client. The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

parameters.name: vehicle
parameters.description: A script's vehicle with no player in it, not a traffic car; or any car a player drives, for a passenger seat.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: Seat index; 0, the driver's, by default.

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: exitVehicle
functions.description: Gets out of its car once the car is nearly still (Enemy_UseCar). The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: driveTo
functions.description: Drives the car it sits in as driver over the road network to the point and stops there (Entity_CarMoveTo). The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Destination; three numbers are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: attack
functions.description: Chases and shoots the target with its best weapon (Entity_ActionFire) until the target is dead (completed) or gone. The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Drops every action and stands (Entity_ActionsClear). The task replaces the current one; npcTaskComplete reports how it ends. Scripted NPCs only.

returns.description: The task id, or 0 when refused (not a living scripted NPC, no host, a target that is gone).

symbols.name: Police
symbols.description: The retail police, which the simulation host runs for every player: each player's crime record, the wanted level it reaches and the officers it sends. Officers come from police walkers and from the traffic's police cars, which also chase players and set up roadblocks.

functions.name: getRecord
functions.description: Returns the player's crime record as the host last reported it.

returns.description: The record, or null when the player is not spawned.

functions.name: setWanted
functions.description: Raises the record to this level, which sends the police the retail way, or lowers it (calling off the officers first). playerWantedChange follows.

returns.description: False when the player is not spawned, no simulation host is attached, or the police are off and the level would rise.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Settles the player's record and calls off every officer after them.

returns.description: False when the player is not spawned or no simulation host is attached.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Turns the police reaction to crimes on or off for everyone. While off, crimes raise nothing, Police.setWanted cannot raise a level and a hit officer opens no new case. Officers already on a case keep it; Police.clear calls them off.

functions.name: isEnabled
functions.description: Whether crimes raise wanted levels.

returns.description: True unless Police.setEnabled(false).

functions.name: setOfficer
functions.description: Makes the player a police officer for the retail police, as retail treats its own officers: no crime record (no crime, wanted level, case, arrest or car hunt for them), and NPCs rate them as a policeman. The record is settled at once (playerWantedChange if they were wanted); Police.setWanted cannot raise it. False turns them back into a citizen with a clean record. The setting lasts until changed or the player leaves.

parameters.name: officer
parameters.description: True on police duty, false back to a citizen.

returns.description: False when the player is unknown.

functions.name: isOfficer
functions.description: Whether Police.setOfficer made the player a police officer.

returns.description: True on police duty.

functions.name: sendBackup
functions.description: Sends a police car with two officers after the player the retail way (the reinforcements a rising wanted level brings): it sets out from a road about 140 m away and hunts them as their wanted level says (kill, arrest or pursue). policeBackup answers whether it set out; the police pool must have two free officers.

returns.description: The request id policeBackup carries, or 0 when the player is not wanted, is an officer, the police are off or no simulation host is attached.

symbols.name: Taxi
symbols.description: Retail taxi passengers. The simulation host runs single player's hailing for every player Taxi.setHailable allows: in a taxi model (taxi, fordapicktaxi, phantomtaxi and retail's hot rods) at 20 m/s or less with no passenger, a walker 20 to 90 m ahead waves (taxiHail), turns to the cab and keeps waving; when the taxi stops within 10 m (taxiPickup) a script boards it (Taxi.board). It becomes an NPC passenger that gets into the back, rides on every client, and gets out when Taxi.dropOff says so or the driver leaves the driver's seat.

functions.name: isPending

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a script wrapper for an existing entity with this ID; it does not spawn an entity.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this entity handle for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text containing the network entity ID.

functions.name: setVirtualWorld
functions.description: Moves this entity into another virtual world.

parameters.name: world
parameters.description: Virtual-world identifier used to partition replication and visibility.

functions.name: setVisibleTo
functions.description: Restricts replication of this entity to one owning connection while preserving normal range and visibility checks.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player-owned entity whose connection should exclusively receive this entity, or null to clear the restriction.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Immutable network entity identifier.

properties.name: virtualWorld
properties.description: Current virtual-world identifier.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Authoritative world-space position; assignment forces replicated state.

properties.name: rotation
properties.description: Authoritative rotation; reads return a quaternion and assignments accept a quaternion or Euler angles in degrees.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Arbitrary key/value state carried by this entity. The server writes it and every client that can see the entity receives it; see StateBag.

symbols.name: StateBag
symbols.description: Arbitrary key/value state attached to one replicated entity, reached as `entity.state`. Keys set on the server replicate to every client that can currently see the entity.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Reads one key from this entity's state.

returns.description: The stored value, or undefined when the key is not set.

functions.name: has
functions.description: Checks whether this entity's state holds a key.

returns.description: True when the key is set.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: Lists the keys this entity's state holds, sorted.

returns.description: Every key currently set, in ascending order.

functions.name: toObject
functions.description: Copies this entity's whole state into a plain object.

returns.description: Every key and value currently set. The copy does not track later changes.

functions.name: onChange
functions.description: Watches this entity's state. The filter is applied before the handler runs, so a listener watching one key of one entity is not woken by unrelated changes. The subscription is dropped when the registering resource stops.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only report this key, or null to report every key of this entity.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Called as (key: string, value: any, previous: any) with the changed key, its new value and the value before it. `value` is undefined when the key was removed and `previous` is undefined when it held nothing.

returns.description: A zero-argument function that cancels this subscription.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Writes one key of this entity's state and replicates it to whoever the scope names. Throws when a limit is reached.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key to write; at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to store. Booleans, numbers and strings travel as themselves; anything else is serialized as JSON. At most 4096 bytes.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Who the key reaches: every client that can see the entity (the default), only its owning client, or nobody -- server-side storage that never goes on the wire.

returns.description: True when the value changed, false when it was already stored.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes one key from this entity's state, telling every client that held it.

returns.description: True when the key was set and has been removed.
